Kraken Habano is a premium hookah tobacco flavor built around rich Habano-style cigar leaf — meaning it’s crafted to give you a bold, earthy, and robust tobacco experience rather than sweet or candy-like fruit notes. “Habano” traditionally refers to full-bodied, spicy, and complex tobacco with pepper, leather, and roasted nut character that’s deep and satisfying for tobacco lovers. What to expect from Kraken Habano 🔥 Rich tobacco backbone — more like a classic cigar vibe than a sugary shisha 🌶 Spicy & peppery edge — a signature trait of Habano leaf ☕ Earthy, leathery depth — with subtle nutty, cocoa, or woodsy tones 💨 Complex, full-flavored smoke — great on its own or mixed with subtle accents like coffee or spice Kraken as a brand often uses premium cigar tobacco blends in its hookah products, giving them more depth and body than standard fruit shishas — so the Habano variant leans into that cigar-like richness and boldness.

A molasses catcher is a dedicated hookah accessory or built-in feature that traps excess shisha molasses (tobacco juices and sticky residue) before it enters the hookah stem and vase. It’s designed to keep your hookah base cleaner, prolong flavor purity between bowls, and reduce how often you need to deep-clean the shaft and water — especially when using very juicy shisha.

Moze – “Flare” Charcoal Basket Premium Metal Construction • Safe Coal Transport • Sleek Modern Design The perfect blend of safety, functionality, and striking design. The Moze Flare Charcoal Basket is an essential, high-quality accessory designed to safely hold and transport glowing hot coconut coals. Crafted from premium, heat-resistant metal, this carrier ensures maximum durability and longevity even under extreme daily temperatures. It features Moze’s signature modern aesthetic with precision-cut “flare” detailing, which allows for optimal airflow while keeping ash securely contained within the deep base. The extended, ergonomic handle keeps your hand safely away from the heat source, making coal management effortless and secure. Whether for a bustling lounge environment or your personal home sessions, the Moze Flare is a stylish, highly practical must-have for maintaining a clean and premium hookah setup.

Finally back! The Moze Sphere 2 is the successor of the successful Moze Sphere. Let yourself be enchanted by the unique look and the stunning blow-off. Smokelab Mummy hookah bowl The relief-adorned Mummy is made from natural clay using milk firing technology. The shape of the bowl makes the process of packing tobacco of any kind as simple and clean as possible. It has slots on the central volcano-style hole that do not allow the foil to stick, and a special groove for the kaloud. Heats up evenly and preserves the temperature. Buy 5 piece and get $4 off on each.

Harvik Mummy Milk The elegant Mummy bowl from Harvik is made from high-quality natural clay. Thanks to the special technique of firing the clay in milk, the bowl acquires not only water resistance and heat resistance, but also a special warm shade. Suitable for all types of tobacco, with a capacity of 10-15 g. Great for smoking on both foil and kaloud.

Sarma Russian Tobacco 100g – Arctic Cloudberry Northern Gold • Tart Honey • Burley & Virginia Blend • 100g Experience the “Siberian Gold” in every puff. Sarma Arctic Cloudberry 100g is a sophisticated tribute to the rarest and most prized berry of the northern wetlands. This profile captures the unique, complex flavor of cloudberries: a delicate balance of honey-like sweetness, creamy texture, and a characteristic tart finish. Built on Sarma’s signature Burley and Virginia dark leaf base, it delivers a medium-strength session with exceptional heat resilience. The earthy, chocolatey tobacco undertones act as a perfect anchor for the berry’s ethereal aromatics, producing dense, aromatic clouds that maintain their exotic, forest-fresh clarity from the first pull to the last.

Sarma Russian Tobacco 100g – Arctic Raspberry Northern Raspberry • Cooling Frost • Burley & Virginia Blend • 100g Experience the bracing fusion of the Siberian wild and arctic frost. Sarma Arctic Raspberry 100g is a sophisticated take on the traditional “Berry & Ice” profile, trading syrupy candy notes for the hyper-realistic taste of wild northern raspberries. This blend captures the specific tartness of berries picked at the first frost, balanced by a smooth, lingering sweetness and a crisp cooling sensation that mimics a frozen forest morning. Built on Sarma’s signature Burley and Virginia dark leaf base, it delivers a satisfying medium-strength session with exceptional heat resistance. The earthy tobacco undertones ground the zesty berry top notes, producing dense, aromatic clouds that stay refreshing and vivid from the very first pull.

Sarma Russian Tobacco 100g – Baikal Pine Needles • Forest Herbs • Black Tea • Burley & Virginia • 100g The legendary flavor of the Siberian wild. Sarma Baikal 100g is the brand’s signature namesake profile, inspired by the world’s deepest lake and the iconic Soviet-era herbal soda. This complex, sophisticated blend captures the essence of the taiga: featuring resinous notes of Siberian pine needles, aromatic forest herbs, and a deep, tannins-rich base of black tea. Built on Sarma’s premium Burley and Virginia dark leaf blend, it offers a medium-strength session with exceptional heat resistance. It is an atmospheric masterpiece that delivers a woody, slightly spicy, and bracingly fresh smoke, producing dense clouds that carry the true spirit of the Siberian wilderness.

Sarma Russian Tobacco 100g – Baikal Strawberry Wild Strawberry • Forest Notes • Burley & Virginia Blend • 100g Taste the concentrated essence of a Siberian summer. Sarma Baikal Strawberry 100g is a masterclass in hyper-realistic berry profiles. Unlike candy-style strawberries, this blend captures the deep, aromatic soul of “Zemlyanika” (wild forest strawberry). It balances a dense, honey-like sweetness with the subtle tartness of sun-ripened berries and a faint, earthy green note reminiscent of the forest floor. Built on Sarma’s signature Burley and Virginia base, it delivers a smooth, medium-strength buzz and exceptional heat resistance, ensuring the delicate berry notes remain vibrant throughout your entire session.

Sarma Russian Tobacco 100g – Baikal Thyme Mountain Thyme • Siberian Herbs • Pine & Forest Air • 100g Breathe in the aromatic soul of the Siberian highlands. Sarma Baikal Thyme 100g is a sophisticated, herbal masterpiece that elevates the brand’s signature forest profile with the addition of wild mountain thyme. This blend captures a vivid, botanical landscape: the pungent, savory-sweet notes of fresh thyme are layered over a base of resinous pine needles and deep forest herbs. Built on Sarma’s signature Burley and Virginia dark leaf base, it delivers a smooth, medium-strength session with exceptional heat resistance. It is an incredibly “atmospheric” smoke—ideal for those who appreciate savory, herbal complexities over traditional sweetness, producing dense clouds that carry a clean, restorative, and earthy finish.

Sarma Russian Tobacco 100g – Banana Soufflé Creamy Banana • Airy Dessert • Burley & Virginia Blend • 100g Indulge in the velvety elegance of a gourmet pastry shop. This isn’t just a standard banana flavor; it combines a natural, ripe banana sweetness with a distinct creamy “baked” note and a hint of airy confectioner’s sugar. Built on Sarma’s signature Burley and Virginia dark leaf base, it delivers a smooth, medium-strength session with exceptional heat resilience. The earthy tobacco undertones provide a sophisticated “crust-like” depth, producing dense, aromatic clouds that maintain their creamy, dessert-inspired clarity from the first pull to the very last.

Sarma Russian Tobacco 100g – Base (No Aroma) Raw Burley & Virginia Blend • Natural Tobacco • DIY Mixing • 100g The foundation of the perfect session. Sarma Base 100g is the “unflavored” masterpiece designed for the true hookah enthusiast and mixologist. Crafted from a high-quality blend of Burley and Virginia leaves without any added flavorings, it showcases the natural, earthy, and slightly chocolatey notes of premium Russian tobacco. This “No Aroma” edition is the ultimate tool for controlling your session: use it to add body and nicotine strength to lighter blonde leaves, or smoke it pure to appreciate the clean, robust profile of the Baikal-inspired leaf. Sarma Russian Tobacco 100g – Buckthorn Orange Sea Buckthorn • Juicy Orange • Burley & Virginia Blend • 100g Experience a vibrant explosion of Siberian sunshine. Sarma Buckthorn Orange 100g is a sophisticated, high-contrast blend that pairs the exotic, oil-rich tartness of wild sea buckthorn with the familiar, zesty sweetness of ripe oranges.
